# `modules/EditorUIComponents.js`

> **Source:** `editor/js/modules/EditorUIComponents.js`

EditorUIComponents.js - Custom UI Components for the Editor Includes: Toast Notifications, Theme System, Context Menu, Tooltips

## Functions

### `showToast(message, options = {})`

Show a toast notification

**Parameters:**

- `message` *(string)* — Message to display
- `options` *(Object)* — Toast options
- `options.type` *(string)* — 'info' | 'success' | 'warning' | 'error'
- `options.duration` *(number)* — Auto-dismiss time in ms (0 = persistent)
- `options.action` *(string)* — Optional action button text
- `options.onAction` *(Function)* — Action button callback

### `setTheme(themeName)`

Apply a theme by name - delegates to themeManager

### `getCurrentTheme()`

Get current theme name

### `getThemes()`

Get all available themes

### `initTheme()`

Initialize theme from localStorage

### `showThemePicker()`

Show theme picker dialog with categories

### `showContextMenu(event, items)`

Show a custom context menu

**Parameters:**

- `event` *(MouseEvent)* — The right-click event
- `items` *(Array)* — Menu items [{label, icon?, action?, separator?, disabled?, submenu?}]

### `hideContextMenu()`

### `initTooltips()`

Initialize tooltip system

### `showShortcutsHelp()`

## Notes & Examples

### Editor Extension System

The editor supports extensions via the same Plauna component system as apps. Extensions can add panels, tools, menu items, and hooks into the engine. They run with elevated 'editor' capability granting access to the scene graph, asset database, and build pipeline.

**Example: Editor extension adding a custom panel**
```js
import { Extension } from 'editor/core/Extension.js';
import { Panel } from 'editor/ui/Panel.js';

class TerrainEditor extends Extension {
  id = 'terrain-editor';
  capabilities = ['editor', 'scene'];
  
  activate(context) {
    // Add menu item
    context.menus.add('Tools/Terrain', () => this.open());
    
    // Register tool
    context.tools.register('terrain', {
      icon: 'mountain',
      onSelect: (entity) => this.edit(entity)
    });
  }
  
  open() {
    this.panel = new Panel({
      title: 'Terrain Editor',
      content: this.buildUI()
    });
    context.workspace.addPanel(this.panel);
  }
  
  edit(entity) {
    const terrain = entity.get(TerrainComponent);
    this.panel.bind(terrain);
  }
}

editor.extensions.register(TerrainEditor);
```
